{{Quote|It's borrowed, but I've taken kind of a fancy to it.|Etahn A'baht|<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>}}
The '''orbital jumper''' was a light [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] produced by [[Poranji]]. Not [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable, [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] jumpers were popular on [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for travel in near-[[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. [[Starship/Legends|Vessels]] of this type were used by high-ranking military and government [[Officer/Legends|officers]] for travel on short notice during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].

==Characteristics==
The orbital jumper was a three-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long light [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] designed for short-range applications such as intercontinental travel or transit from the ground to [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] facilities like [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhooks]]. Unmodified units had only [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for primary motive power and had limited [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] for maneuvering. This allowed a maximum [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] speed of 650 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] without the ability to travel beyond orbital [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. They were sold unarmed and were able to carry a total of four [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized beings, including the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. At 35,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new or 20,000 credits used,<ref name="CTD" /> the [[Poranji]] orbital jumper was the smallest ground-to-orbit craft licensed for use on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="BTS" />

Some units were upgraded to leave orbit and were capable of traveling as far as a nearby [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. This was not common, as there were numerous alternative methods of in-[[Star system/Legends|system]] travel that were faster, less expensive, and more efficient.<ref name="CTD" />

==History==
Poranji's orbital jumper model was first used around [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]. They were considered a coveted status symbol among the youth of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="CTD" /> One vehicle of this class was parked at [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] Coruscant residence on [[Victory Lake]] in the early stages of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Etahn A'baht]] found the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] appealing, and he was able to borrow it for his transit from Coruscant to his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], [[Intrepid (Endurance-class)|''Intrepid'']]. He quickly took a liking to the craft and asked his [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]], [[Marty]], to take good care of it.<ref name="BTS" />

[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] also had an orbital jumper, which she used to visit retired [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] later during the crisis.<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The orbital jumper first appeared in ''[[Before the Storm]]'', the first book of [[1996]]'s ''[[The Black Fleet Crisis]]'' by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]], and last appeared in the final book of that trilogy, ''[[Tyrant's Test]]''. Specifications and a visual depiction were later provided in [[1997]]'s ''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''. After this, the ship made no appearances in any ''[[Star Wars]]'' products until the [[2008]] release of ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which added no new information.

The ship A'baht flies the jumper to is identified once in the story as the ''[[Glorious]]'', but the ''Glorious'' had already been established as being away from Coruscant in pursuit of the [[Teljkon Vagabond]], and A'baht's flagship was identified as the ''Intrepid'' both earlier and later in the book.<ref name="BTS" />
